newsitem.title: USA: US 1 sees Q1 loss, Q2 breakeven.
newsitem.headline: US 1 sees Q1 loss, Q2 breakeven.

text.p: US 1 Industries Inc expects to post a loss for the first quarter and break even in the second quarter, Michael Kibler, president of the Gary, Ind.-based interstate trucking and logistics company, told Reuters in an interview.
"We're not going to be profitable in the first quarter," Kibler said, adding "We're hoping to break even in the second quarter and make money in the third quarter."
Earlier Tuesday, US 1 posted 1996 earnings of $0.02 per share which included gains from discontinued operations and early retirement of debt.

"While (1996) revenue increased over 1995, December and the beginning of 1987 showed weakness," Kibler said, although he added that preliminary data show March results may have been substantially higher than a year earlier.
"We have two significant agent operations coming on line but more are needed in order for the company to accomplish its (current) objectives."
The newest agents are based in South Carolina.
Kibler said US 1, which has about 40 independent agents under contract, is "actively looking to add more new agents."
